author: Inside Edition
description: Police in New Jersey are asking for the public's to assist them in identifying a John Doe who was found on the Jersey Shore 44 years ago in the seaside town of Brigantine in May 1982. The case has been cold and now thanks to forensic imaging and technological advances, police can now show what the John Doe may have looked like and hope to crack the case. Anyone with information on the identity of the man can contact Lt. J. Glasser at the Brigantine Police Department at 609-266-7414 or jglasser@brigantinenj.gov and the New Jersey State Police Missing Persons Unit at 609-882-2000, ext. 2554 or missingpinformation@njsp.gov. Those reporting any information can do so anonymously if they wish.
title: Police Seek Public's Help In Identifying John Doe Found On Jersey Shore In 1982
